Background: golden sand dunes under a clear sky with a smooth flat sand foreground and a standard-height wooden gate frame standing at her side, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle.
